title: Greek Sausage Saganaki Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy Italian-inspired skillet dish featuring Greek sausages, saganaki, and a burst of citrusy freshness.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and sauté the saganaki until golden brown.
Add the bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Return the sausages to the skillet and stir in the lemon juice.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve with crusty bread, if desired.
